trigger.request_payload: Develop and release QIF v0.8.1 Portable Pattern Library Import. Need: portable agent skills and reusable workflows are becoming cross-platform standards, but reusable quality knowledge can be copied without provenance, applicability boundaries, counterexamples, trust state, or local validation. Intent: extend standalone qif-ledger with an executable import contract that keeps imported Decision Patterns and Quality Intents candidate-only until v0.8.2 local applicability and reproduction. Context: preserve original source identity and evidence, reject executable instructions and hidden reasoning, prevent imported content from granting authority or active status, add deterministic verifier rules, examples, retained negative fixtures, docs, portable package, roadmap, changelog, AOF evidence, tag, and GitHub release.

outcome_reports.note: QIF v0.8.1 implements exact-source, digest-verified, candidate-only Portable Pattern Library Import with provenance, applicability boundaries, counterexamples, trust, non-executable and authority boundaries, assessment, governance, and open-risk visibility. npm test passed 16/16 and 1331/1331; AOF organization verification passed 295/295. Public release pending.

gaps.summary: The underlying need is not specific enough yet.
The intended direction is not yet explicit.
Key constraints, scope, and current conditions are missing.
Forbidden changes or non-negotiables are not explicit.

asked_questions: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?

user_answers.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
user_answers.answer: Scope the standalone qif-ledger schema, example, verifier, retained fixtures, documentation, AI guide, roadmap, portable package, changelog, and release. Keep UI, external registries, provider-specific skill loaders, automatic activation, executable imported instructions, employee surveillance, and operational truth claims out of scope.

user_answers.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
user_answers.answer: Success means an imported pattern/intent library preserves exact source identity, provenance, applicability boundaries, counterexamples, evidence/trust state, and immutable source payload; every import remains candidate-only and non-authoritative; any attempt to activate, silently alter, omit required source context, or treat imported instructions as executable is rejected by retained verifier fixtures.
